Superscript One Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Superscript One is 0185. Hold Alt, type 0185 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Superscript One also has the Unicode codepoint U+00B9, so you can type it with Alt+185 on Windows, search for U+00B9 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ¹ in HTML, or \00B9 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Superscript One character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity ¹ for Superscript One, but the numeric form ¹ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type superscript one on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 8 5 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Superscript One character (¹) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type superscript one on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Superscript One. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Superscript One" and click the character to insert it.

How to use superscript one in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00B9"; ()
  • Python: \u00B9 or chr(0xB9)
  • JavaScript: \u00B9 or String.fromCodePoint(0xB9)
  • JSON: "\u00B9"
  • LaTeX: $^1$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Superscript One?

The legacy Alt code for Superscript One is 0185. Hold Alt, type 0 1 8 5 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ¹ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ¹, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+185 not work?

Alt+185 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Superscript One?

The Unicode codepoint for Superscript One is U+00B9. You can use this value in HTML as ¹, in CSS as \00B9, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ¹ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00B9, then click it.
